Authors: He P.; Zhu J.; Zheng Z.; Lyu M.R.
Title: Drain: An Online Log Parsing Approach with Fixed Depth Tree
Source title: Proceedings - 2017 IEEE 24th International Conference on Web Services, ICWS 2017
Abstract: Logs record what a system does at runtime, and most log analysis starts by turning raw messages into templates. We present an online parser that walks a tree of fixed depth and evaluate it on five real-world log datasets. © 2017 IEEE.

Authors: Zhang X.; Xu Y.; Lin Q.; Qiao B.
Title: Robust log-based anomaly detection on unstable log data
Source title: ESEC/FSE 2019 - Proceedings of the 2019 27th ACM Joint Meeting on European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software Engineering
Abstract: Log statements change as software evolves, which breaks detectors trained on earlier logs. We represent log events by their meaning so that anomaly detection keeps working when the logs change. © 2019 ACM.

Authors: Zhu J.; He S.; Liu J.; He P.; Xie Q.; Zheng Z.; Lyu M.R.
Title: Tools and Benchmarks for Automated Log Parsing
Source title: Proceedings - 2019 IEEE/ACM 41st International Conference on Software Engineering: Software Engineering in Practice, ICSE-SEIP 2019
Abstract:
Many log parsers exist, but they are rarely compared on the same data.
This study benchmarks thirteen parsers on sixteen datasets and reports their accuracy, robustness and efficiency, "as used in practice".
